facility_roles.quote: currently undergoing the final stages of installation and commissioning at the Laboratoire Souterrain de Modane (LSM), in France

intervals.label: assembly completed and commissioning
intervals.note: Start = completion of the basic assembly of the Demonstrator at LSM (November 2018); the sources do not date the start of commissioning itself, nor the earlier construction. The 2018-2020 report says 'The calorimeter is fully commissioned and the tracker commissioning is under progress'; a December 2024 paper still speaks of 'the final stages of installation and commissioning'.
intervals.quote: The most important result is the completion of the basic assembly of the SuperNEMO Demonstrator in November 2018

intervals.label: data taking
intervals.note: First ββ event recorded 10 April 2025; the June 2025 status talk reports 'Now in full data taking mode'. No later source was found, so whether data taking continues on 2026-10-26 is not confirmed.

quantity.note: 34 foils, 96-99 % enriched. The 2018-2020 report and the 2024 calorimeter paper give 6.3 kg and 6.11 kg respectively.

quantity.quote: The SuperNEMO Demonstrator’s calorimeter consists of 712 plastic scintillator blocks read out by large PMTs.

lineage.locator: slide 'The SuperNEMO demonstrator: a technology demonstrator module'
lineage.note: Also: 'SuperNEMO is a next generation experiment building on technology used by the currently running NEMO-III experiment' (arXiv:1005.1241, section 3) and 'SuperNEMO – successor of NEMO-3' (JINR PAC talk, January 2021).

name: SuperNEMO demonstrator
notes: The Demonstrator is the first module of the planned SuperNEMO experiment; only the Demonstrator is recorded. It is a technology demonstrator as well as a physics experiment.
Expected sensitivity quoted by the collaboration (2018-2020 report): T1/2 > 6e24 yr with 6.3 kg of 82Se in 2.5 years. No physics result has been published yet.
No official website was reachable; none is recorded.

physics_goals.quote: The SuperNEMO experiment is searching for neutrinoless double-beta-decay of 82 Se, with the unique combination of a tracking detector and a segmented calorimeter.
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double beta decay of 82Se, with a tracker that records each electron's path and a segmented calorimeter, to probe the decay mechanism as well as its existence

summary.plain: The first module of SuperNEMO, in the Modane underground laboratory. Thin selenium-82 foils sit between a gas tracker and a wall of plastic scintillators, so each decay electron is followed track by track. It recorded its first double beta event in April 2025.
summary.technical: SuperNEMO Demonstrator Module: 34 82Se foils (6.11 kg), a 2034-cell Geiger tracker and 712 scintillator-PMT optical modules, with a ~25 G coil, iron, polyethylene and anti-radon shielding at LSM (4800 m.w.e.). Successor to NEMO-3; goal 0vbb of 82Se with measurement of the electron energies and angle.
